items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: Cannonball Adderley. I mean all of them.

ctx.x: Cannonball Adderley. I mean all of them. And with Guy you hear just that one note, it’s not even part of the note he’s playing —

The feeling, the emotion, yeah, the tone he’s using is very deep. You worked also with people working for soundtracks on movies and films like Michel Legrand — I’d like you to tell a few words about Michel. How was your experience working with such a great composer?
